description: Book tattoo sessions at Fresh Ink, an appointment-only custom linework studio in Saint Paul, MN. Tools: get_studio_info, list_open_times, hold_slot, get_booking_status. Free while in proof of concept — no payment step.
name: fresh-ink-booking
title: Fresh Ink Booking

tools.description: Studio name, address, hours, prices and how booking works. Call first.
tools.name: get_studio_info

tools.description: List open appointment times between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD, max 31 days, America/Chicago).
tools.name: list_open_times

tools.description: Hold an open time for 15 minutes on behalf of the user. Returns a checkout_url the USER must open to lock the session in (free while in proof of concept — no payment). Confirm the details with the user before calling.
tools.name: hold_slot

tools.description: Check a held booking: pending (awaiting lock-in), confirmed, expired or cancelled.
tools.name: get_booking_status
